summary: Iteration 2 testing: 5 new features (Twilio proxy call graceful degradation, Leaflet map on accepted orders, referral rewards, SMS alerts log-and-skip, Admin Live Pricing Editor). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS (pricing seed + dynamic price + invalid price 400 + admin auth 401/403; referral code SSXXXXXX format, prefill via referral_code, seller/stats fields, end-to-end referral bonus flow +50, no double-credit on second order; Twilio status configured:false, /call 503 unconfigured, non-participant 403, seller-before-accept 400; feed masks seller_mobile correctly '91 XXXXXX##'; admin/summary has twilio_configured:false). Frontend: register-referral input prefills from ?ref=SSTEST12 URL correctly; seller dashboard shows referral-card + referral-code (SSB47309) + copy-referral-btn; collector shows twilio-warning banner + 'Call Disabled' label + disabled=true; accepted order card renders MapCard with data-testid map-{orderId} + Leaflet dark tiles + Directions external btn (map-{orderId}-external-btn); admin Pricing tab edits Paper (pricing-input-Paper + pricing-save-Paper) with 'Paper rate updated to ₹15/kg' toast; Referrals tab displays payout table with the earned ₹50 entry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~640 lines and growing - consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/orders.py, routers/admin.py, services/twilio.py for maintainability.
orders/feed does an N+1 query: iterates feed docs and calls db.orders.find_one for each to get seller_mobile. Refactor to include seller_mobile in initial query and mask in Python without leaking.
MapCard hits public Nominatim/OSRM directly from browser with no rate limit or caching - risk of throttling/CORS if traffic grows. Consider server-side geocode caching in db.geocache.
AuthModal DialogContent missing aria-describedby (React warning in console). Add DialogDescription for accessibility.
generate_referral_code() has a tiny (2^24) collision risk with no uniqueness check on insert - add unique index on users.referral_code.
test_credentials: Seller 9999911111/pass123; Collector 8888822222/pass123 (Chandrashekhar Scrap); Admin passkey 8762 - all working.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed seller/collector accounts with unique timestamp-based mobile numbers; ~10+ pending Paper/Plastic orders remain from test runs (auto-purge kicks in at 24h). One order accepted by main collector during UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration-2 features verified end-to-end (backend + frontend + integration). Twilio env vars intentionally empty — do NOT try to configure. If retesting: rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_smart_scrap.py -v` for backend regression. Frontend map render depends on public Nominatim which can be flaky — screenshot confirmed working. Referral bonus is one-time (first-completed pickup) and enforced by counting completed orders == 1.
